title: Chris Minns’ backflips are adding up. Is he ‘clearing the runway’ or panicking?
summary_full: From train timetables to coffee cups and property underquoting, the NSW premier is making policy reversals well ahead of the March electionGet our daily political email, free app or daily news podcastIf recent coverage is to be believed, the New South Wales premier, Chris Minns, is a talented gymnast. A last-minute intervention by the premier on Monday afternoon, the day before a suite of reforms on underquoting were due to take effect, marks a quadruple or quintuple policy “backflip” by Minns in recent weeks, depending on who you ask.The laws banning real estate agents from lowering the advertised price of a property beneath a previously rejected written offer have been shelved for up to a year, after the premier flagged on Monday morning he had received concerns from estate agents in his own electorate about their effect amid a housing market downturn.
